plaintiff: all those persons who purchased and paid more than $100,000.00 for corrugated fibreboard packaging products in Australia during the period 1 May 2000 to 1 May 2005
charges: alleged contraventions of s 45 of the Trade Practices Act 1974 (Cth) alleging that arrangements were made between the Amcor and Visy companies which related to the fixing, controlling or maintaining of prices for the supply of corrugated fibre board packaging products
counsel_for_applicant: Mr. L. Armstrong, Maurice Blackburn Cashman Pty Ltd
counsel_for_respondent: Mr. P Solomon, Allens Arthur Robinson; Mr. M. H.O'Bryan, Arnold Bloch Leibler
